claims.statement: 布局入口 computeGraphLayout 是 async 且按 layoutMode 分派：topology 用 bundled headless ELK（fixed layered/RIGHT/INCLUDE_CHILDREN/ORTHOGONAL、NETWORK_SIMPLEX/LAYER_SWEEP、randomSeed=1），swimlane 用纯展示的手排“阶段 × 责任泳道”网格并在 ELK 节点副本上自算坐标与正交线路；两者都不依赖 DOM 或文本测量，并返回同一 DomainGraphLayout。
卡片大小按 simplified220×82、standard220×156、expanded240×200 固定。
Context 按父层级形成 compound tree、其他对象按 contextRef 归属，空 Context 保留边界，父循环显式拒绝。
跨 Context 或 plays_role 边为 dashed，plays_role 才有箭头；责任 links 仅来自显式 roleRefs（contract_party）/responsibleRoleRef（responsibility），旧 crossing kind 分类已删除。
线路来自 ELK sections 并加 container 世界偏移，缺失/断开路由显式拒绝，不再猜 midpoint。
Ruler ticks use a 1-2-5 ladder and the smallest step whose on-screen width clears the minimum major step, are aligned to the world grid, and keep their labelled positions while panning.

Highlighting never expands past one hop: a node highlights itself, formal neighbours, touching edges, its context chain and responsibility badges; an edge highlights both endpoints; a context highlights its subtree and only internal edges; unknown ids return an empty undimmed result.
editor 持一份 ModelSession，事件读取状态后异步求图，reload 重置历史，不再同步算生命周期泳道。

The inspector is generated from a declarative registry: five declared group ids with labels, property definitions naming field, editor kind, select options, reference constraints and helper text, and only getInspectorGroups/getInspectorGroup/getReferenceConstraint as lookup APIs; the evidence responsibility fields constrain roles to same-context Party Roles, and the per-category sets use only the general, responsibility and attributes groups.
ELK/adapter 测试保护 compound 节点、空 Context、路由容器/sections、pair、密度、父前子及 geometry 一致性。
序列化仅导出命名几何/ID/ELK routed edges/fulfillmentPairs，不含实体或 Map。
React Flow 管视口、partial marquee/fit，不是模型拖拽编辑器（节点不可 draggable/connectable）；缩放范围在 renderer 配置为 0.1–2，wheel zoom 关闭，pane click 清选区，选择变化只回报首个 entity 节点。
adapter 父前子、local box+parentId，显式尺寸和 handles；关系/pairLink 直接消费 ELK 世界坐标路由。

Framing is token-driven: fitToContent fits boundsOf(layout, scope) with 0.08 padding, a change of scope, density or layout mode (swimlane vs topology) refits and clears every hover mark, zoomCommand (in/out/fit/reset/selection) and focusRequest are deduplicated by monotonic tokens so a re-render cannot replay a key press, story focus recentres at 1.15 keyed by focusKey plus the active box, and boundsOf falls back to the scope bounds or the layout bounds with a 1 px minimum.

The viewport hands its floating island a CanvasHudControls contract (zoom, zoom in/out, reset to 1:1, fit to content, grid style, minimap toggle), and the app's CanvasFloatingHud adds workspace concerns on top — pointer/clear selection, card density, topology vs swimlane layout toggle, story entry, view mode and split target — while object creation is deliberately absent because a Context and role bindings must exist first.

NodeCard draws a business object as a sticky note with a category spine and a clock shape (interval for rfp, proposal and fulfillment_request; moment for contract and fulfillment_confirmation; card otherwise) plus party, responsibility and API-route badges and standard-density metadata, and makes out-of-scope objects non-interactive; EntityNode adds only the measured box and invisible handles, and ContextGroupNode is non-interactive paper.
关系边绘 ELK polyline、诊断 halo、cardinality chips、hover label 与组件内计算的 plays_role 箭头，plays_role 在简化密度默认 muted；flowKind 非 primary 时改用违约补偿/争议升级配色、专属 dash 与常显标签，story 激活时改动态 dash 并按方向反向；pairLink 是细虚线无箭头。

createDiagnosticIndex attaches a sensor issue only by explicit reference — a targetNodeId trimmed at # naming a known entity or relationship, else a contextRef naming a real Context — collapses duplicate issue ids and keeps the highest severity per object, and DiagnosticMarkers renders each bucket as an outline plus count badge that hands its issues to the app and skips out-of-scope ids.

computeContextScope is a mask over the canonical placement rather than a second layout: it records the selected Context subtree, the owned objects plus explicit one-hop neighbours, the frames needed to read them with ancestors added as frames only, the touching relationships, and bounds that exclude unrelated ancestor space.
Inspector 专用属性/派生/履约面板调用 session.mutate 的 guarded mutators，变更共享单批撤销并显示拒绝原因，不再使用 Command 类。

ApiFieldBadge classifies a field as CEL Derived, Service Timestamp or Input through the delivery projection's fieldFor, and KeyDataProvenancePicker shows the ledger's provider verdict with only 'bind a derivation rule' or 'this is not key data' as actions; both verdicts are derived from the document rather than stored as flags.

KeyDataLedgerSheet is the wide ledger, opened from the attribute grid, the inspector footer or Alt+L (only while an object is selected); it edits the same session, states the field and decision-owed counts, edits the active row's expression from a CelFormulaBar, and captures Escape on window with stopPropagation so closing it does not clear the canvas selection.

Rule editing is the one CodeMirror surface the inspector owns: CelCodeMirrorEditor mounts CodeMirror with autocompletion from computeCelCompletions over model-derived CelCandidates, a 200 ms linter over analyzeCelExpression whose verdict is a guard rather than the authority, and commits on blur or Mod+Enter exactly once, replacing the draft only when an external value differs.

The code-surface dependency boundary is split: ui-kit exports CodeEditor plus its own CEL tokenizer and the desktop renderer imports no @codemirror/*, while feature-inspector depends on @codemirror/* for the editing surface and ships a second, richer tokenizer that tracks member reads — so a newly allowed CEL builtin must be added to both celLanguage files or the read-only and editing views colour the same expression differently.
useGraphLayout 只在异步结果属于当前 (graph, viewMode, layoutMode) 三元组时发布几何：迟到结果按 cancelled 标记丢弃，未匹配时对外是空的 EMPTY_GRAPH_LAYOUT 加 layoutPending，失败时同样清空几何并暴露 layoutError，由 EditorScreen 显示计算中/失败提示。
swimlane 布局是纯展示：阶段由凭证 kind 决定，泳道由合同 roleRefs、responsibleRoleRef、party 角色自身以及固定的共同约定/能力支撑组成，阶段宽度跨 Context 对齐、嵌套 Context 依次堆叠，区域盒只存在于 swimlaneRegions 与 SwimlaneOverlay，不进业务模型。
swimlane 的线路显式避障：默认右出并走行下方走廊，一旦某段会穿过任何卡片就改走 root 右缘主干，因此两种布局模式下边都不刺穿卡片。

applyStoryFocus 在 convertLayoutToReactFlow 之后覆盖 hover/选择的 dim：involved 节点不透明、无关节点 0.35 且 dimmed 置 false，活动卡片带 pulse class，只有连接活动实体与其依赖的边（含 pairLink）被动画且方向由 source 决定 storyReversed；焦点为 null 或实体已消失时原样返回。
故事焦点由 app 侧 useStoryPlayback 从当前 flow step 生成（活动实体、basedOn 依赖、acting/responsible 角色、focusKey 含 flow/step/sequence/stepHash），播放期间 scope 被置空并撤掉范围控件，避免推演画面被遮罩裁掉。
违约/争议标记是模型事实而非高亮：关系上的 flowKind（primary/breach_compensation/escalation）由边画成固定配色、专属 dash 与常显标签，不依赖 hover 或选中；该字段由 RelationshipFlowSection 通过 session.mutate 设置，并声明标记不代表履约完成或法务批准。
业务公式是 native CEL AST 上的无损视图：token 保存精确源码切片与只用于展示的 label，拼接 token.text 可逐字还原源串；替换前校验原切片并用 translateBusinessFormula 重新解析，失败返回 null 且界面报“未保存”不提交；注释、集合绑定、运行时标量与未解析别名整体回退为 CEL 源码模式。
CelFormulaBar 只编辑已存在的派生规则表达式并走 updateRuleMutator，把普通输入字段变成派生字段的绑定决定留在属性行，所以公式栏改常量、插入计算与源码编辑都落在同一条规则表达式和同一份 ModelSession 历史上。
